blocks.en: Section 1: Test Methods & Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 能夠描述 BIER（生物指示劑評估抗性計）的功能及使用 ISO 18472 設備標準的要求
blocks.en: Describe the function of the BIER (Biological Indicator Evaluator Resistometer) and the requirement to use equipment meeting ISO 18472

blocks.zh: 掌握 D 值測定所需的最低實驗設計：20 個複本、至少 5 個暴露條件、共 100 次測試
blocks.en: Understand the minimum experimental design for D-value determination: 20 replicates, at least 5 exposure conditions, 100 tests in total

blocks.zh: 理解 Survival Time（存活時間）和 Kill Time（殺滅時間）的定義及其與 D 值之間的關係
blocks.en: Understand the definitions of Survival Time and Kill Time and their relationship to the D-value

blocks.zh: 了解 D 值計算的三種方法（LSK、Survival Curve、Stumbo-Murphy-Cochran），以及選擇方法的一致性要求
blocks.en: Know the three methods of D-value calculation (LSK, Survival Curve, Stumbo-Murphy-Cochran) and the requirement to use the chosen method consistently

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: D-Value（D 值）：在特定滅菌條件下，使孢子數量減少 90%（一個 log cycle）所需的時間，單位通常為分鐘。D 值越大，代表微生物的抗性越強。
blocks.en: D-Value: The time required under defined sterilization conditions to reduce the spore count by 90% (one log cycle), usually expressed in minutes. The larger the D-value, the more resistant the microorganism.

blocks.zh: BIER Vessel（生物指示劑評估抗性計）：一種精密的實驗室設備，能在嚴格控制的條件下（溫度、壓力、時間）暴露 BI，以測定其 D 值。ISO 18472 規定了 BIER 的性能標準。
blocks.en: BIER Vessel (Biological Indicator Evaluator Resistometer): A precision laboratory instrument that exposes BIs under tightly controlled conditions (temperature, pressure, time) in order to determine their D-value. ISO 18472 specifies the performance standards for BIER vessels.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — D 值的意義
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — Meaning of the D-Value

blocks.zh:
D 值定義：
在恆定滅菌條件下，使初始孢子數
減少 1 個 log（即 90%）所需的時間

示例：
初始孢子數 = 10^6 CFU
D 值 = 2 分鐘
→ 暴露 2 min 後：10^5 CFU（減少 1 log）
→ 暴露 4 min 後：10^4 CFU（減少 2 log）
→ 暴露 12 min 後：<1 CFU（理論滅菌）

SAL 12-log 計算：
滅菌時間 = D 值 × (log N₀ + log 1/SAL)
= D × (6 + 6) = 12D
（SAL = 10^-6）
blocks.en:
D-value definition:
The time required, under constant sterilization conditions,
to reduce the initial spore count by 1 log (i.e. 90%)

Example:
Initial spore count = 10^6 CFU
D-value = 2 minutes
→ After 2 min exposure: 10^5 CFU (1 log reduction)
→ After 4 min exposure: 10^4 CFU (2 log reduction)
→ After 12 min exposure: <1 CFU (theoretical sterility)

SAL 12-log calculation:
Sterilization time = D-value × (log N₀ + log 1/SAL)
= D × (6 + 6) = 12D
(SAL = 10^-6)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「多相滅菌製程（multiple-phase sterilization processes）目前沒有可用的 D 值測定方法」——這是一個重要的局限性聲明。意味著像乾熱/濕熱複合、或 VHP + 熱的組合製程，目前無法用傳統 D 值來描述其滅菌動力學。這對新型滅菌技術的驗證策略有重大影響。
blocks.en: "No D-value determination method is currently available for multiple-phase sterilization processes" is an important statement of limitation. It means that processes such as combined dry heat/moist heat, or VHP combined with heat, cannot currently be described by their sterilization kinetics using the conventional D-value. This has a major impact on the validation strategy for novel sterilization technologies.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 BIER 裝置的「設計差異可以被接受」，但必須符合 ISO 18472 的性能要求？這兩者之間的關係說明什麼監管哲學？
blocks.en: Why can "design differences" in BIER vessels be accepted as long as they meet the ISO 18472 performance requirements? What regulatory philosophy does the relationship between the two reflect?

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠使用一種新型組合滅菌製程，而 USP 〈55〉 說沒有 D 值方法，你會如何驗證這個製程？
blocks.en: If your facility uses a new combination sterilization process and USP <55> says there is no D-value method, how would you validate that process?

blocks.zh: D-Value Determination — Procedure D 值測定 — 操作程序
blocks.en: D-Value Determination — Procedure

blocks.zh: 20 複本 × 5 條件 = 100 次測試的邏輯：D 值測定需要足夠的統計信心。每個暴露時間點用 20 個 BI，跨越從「全部存活」到「全部被殺滅」的時間範圍，才能繪製可靠的存活曲線（survival curve）並計算 D 值。
blocks.en: The logic of 20 replicates × 5 conditions = 100 tests: D-value determination needs sufficient statistical confidence. Each exposure time point uses 20 BIs, spanning the range from "all survive" to "all killed", so that a reliable survival curve can be plotted and the D-value calculated.

blocks.zh: 時間間隔 NMT 75% of D-value：相鄰暴露時間的間距不超過預期 D 值的 75%，確保數據點足夠密集，避免在曲線上出現過大的空白區間，提高計算精度。
blocks.en: Time interval NMT 75% of D-value: The spacing between adjacent exposure times must not exceed 75% of the expected D-value. This keeps the data points dense enough, avoids large gaps along the curve, and improves calculation precision.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: D 值測定就像在測試一座城牆的抵抗力——你需要用不同強度和時間的衝擊測試，從「城牆完好」到「城牆倒塌」的整個範圍，才能準確估算城牆真正的崩潰點。20 個 BI 在每個時間點就是你的觀察樣本，5 個不同時間條件確保你涵蓋了整個崩潰過程。
blocks.en: D-value determination is like testing the resistance of a city wall: you need impact tests of varying intensity and duration, covering the whole range from "wall intact" to "wall collapsed", to estimate the true breaking point accurately. The 20 BIs at each time point are your observation samples, and the 5 different time conditions ensure that you cover the entire collapse process.

blocks.zh: 「孢子懸浮液放在橡膠塞等基材上時，抗性可能與純水中測定的結果不同」——這是一個在 CDMO 製造現場非常重要的提醒。如果你的藥品瓶塞（elastomeric closure）接觸到 BI 孢子懸浮液，它的滅菌動力學可能改變。這意味著在容器密封系統 (container-closure system) 相關的滅菌驗證中，必須考慮基材效應（matrix effect）。
blocks.en: "When spore suspensions are placed on substrates such as rubber stoppers, the resistance may differ from that determined in pure water" is a very important reminder on the manufacturing floor of a CDMO. If your drug product stoppers (elastomeric closures) come into contact with a BI spore suspension, their sterilization kinetics may change. This means that matrix effects must be considered in sterilization validation involving the container-closure system.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 廠在進行高壓蒸汽滅菌驗證（autoclave validation）時，通常向 BI 供應商採購已標示 D 值的產品（例如 G. stearothermophilus，D<sub>121</sub> = 1.5 min）。廠商不需要重新測定 D 值，但必須確認入庫 BI 的孢子數符合標示，並使用相同的計算方法（LSK 或廠商指定方法）進行驗收確認。
blocks.en: When performing autoclave validation, a CDMO site usually purchases BIs from a supplier with a labeled D-value (e.g. G. stearothermophilus, D<sub>121</sub> = 1.5 min). The user does not need to re-determine the D-value, but must confirm that the spore count of the incoming BIs matches the label, and must perform acceptance verification using the same calculation method (LSK or the supplier-specified method).

blocks.zh: 如果一個 BI 供應商聲稱其產品同時適用於蒸汽和 EO 兩種滅菌製程，廠商需要提供哪些數據？
blocks.en: If a BI supplier claims that its product is suitable for both steam and EO sterilization processes, what data should the supplier provide?

blocks.zh: 為什麼時間間隔「NMT 75% of D-value」？如果時間間隔過大（例如 2 倍 D 值），會對結果造成什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why is the time interval "NMT 75% of D-value"? If the interval is too large (e.g. twice the D-value), how does that affect the results?

blocks.zh: Recovery, Calculation, and Survival/Kill Time 回收、計算與存活／殺滅時間
blocks.en: Recovery, Calculation, and Survival/Kill Time

blocks.zh: Survival Time（存活時間）：在此時間暴露後，所有 10 個 BI 樣品必須顯示微生物生長（即孢子存活）。這代表滅菌製程還「不夠」。
blocks.en: Survival Time: After exposure for this time, all 10 BI samples must show microbial growth (i.e. the spores survive). This indicates that the sterilization process is still "insufficient".

blocks.zh: Kill Time（殺滅時間）：在此時間暴露後，所有 10 個 BI 樣品必須顯示無生長（即孢子全滅）。這代表滅菌製程已「足夠」。
blocks.en: Kill Time: After exposure for this time, all 10 BI samples must show no growth (i.e. all spores are killed). This indicates that the sterilization process is "sufficient".

blocks.zh: 兩者之間的關係：Survival Time < 實際殺滅 < Kill Time，D 值的估算必須落在這個範圍內。
blocks.en: Relationship between the two: Survival Time < actual kill < Kill Time; the D-value estimate must fall within this range.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — 三種 D 值計算方法比較
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — Comparison of the Three D-Value Calculation Methods

blocks.zh:
方法                  特點
─────────────────────────────────────
Limited Spearman-    基於 quantal assay（全或無）
Karber (LSK)         不需要中間存活計數
                     計算相對簡單

Survival Curve       直接用存活/不存活數據
Method               繪製曲線計算斜率
                     適合有連續數據的情況

Stumbo-Murphy-       更複雜的統計方法
Cochran              考慮了計數不確定性
                     學術研究中較常見

⚠ 重要：從供應商購入的 BI
必須使用供應商指定的計算方法
不可自行切換方法！
blocks.en:
Method                  Characteristics
─────────────────────────────────────
Limited Spearman-       Based on quantal assay (all or none)
Karber (LSK)            No intermediate survivor counts needed
                        Relatively simple calculation

Survival Curve          Uses survivor/non-survivor data directly
Method                  Plot the curve and calculate the slope
                        Suited to continuous data

Stumbo-Murphy-          More complex statistical method
Cochran                 Accounts for counting uncertainty
                        More common in academic research

⚠ Important: for BIs purchased from a supplier,
you must use the calculation method specified by the supplier.
Do not switch methods on your own!

blocks.zh: NMT 4 小時的時間窗口：滅菌暴露後必須在 4 小時內將 BI 轉移至培養基。時間延遲可能導致孢子死亡（特別是已受損但尚未死亡的孢子）或污染，從而產生假陰性（false negative，即誤以為滅菌有效）。這是 SOP 中必須明確規定的關鍵時間點。
blocks.en: The NMT 4-hour window: After sterilization exposure, the BIs must be transferred to the growth medium within 4 hours. A delay may cause spore death (especially of spores that are damaged but not yet dead) or contamination, producing a false negative (i.e. wrongly concluding that sterilization was effective). This is a critical time point that must be explicitly specified in the SOP.

blocks.zh: 7 天培養觀察：需要連續觀察 7 天，一旦發現生長即可停止。這個時間長度對 G. stearothermophilus（嗜熱菌）尤其重要，因為其生長較慢。
blocks.en: 7-day incubation observation: Observation is required for 7 consecutive days, and may stop as soon as growth is seen. This duration is especially important for G. stearothermophilus (a thermophile), because its growth is slower.

blocks.zh: Survival Time 和 Kill Time 就像做烤雞的溫度測試——你先確定 「在哪個溫度下雞肉還是生的（survival）」，再確定「哪個溫度下雞肉一定熟了（kill）」，然後你的烤雞溫度就必須介於兩者之間靠近 kill 的那一側。同樣，滅菌製程的目標暴露時間必須遠超 Survival Time，並落在 Kill Time 之後。
blocks.en: Survival Time and Kill Time are like temperature testing for a roast chicken: you first determine "at what temperature the chicken is still raw (survival)", then "at what temperature it is definitely cooked (kill)", and your roasting temperature must then fall between the two, close to the kill side. Likewise, the target exposure time of a sterilization process must be well beyond the Survival Time and fall after the Kill Time.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 廠的滅菌週期開發中，BI 供應商提供的 Certificate of Analysis (CoA) 必須包含：D 值（和所用計算方法）、Survival Time、Kill Time 及孢子數量。在你的製程驗證方案（PQ protocol）中，必須明確說明你將採用供應商指定的同一計算方法來確認 D 值。稽查員非常容易發現「廠商用 LSK，但你用 Survival Curve」這類不一致性。
blocks.en: In sterilization cycle development at a CDMO site, the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) from the BI supplier must include the D-value (and the calculation method used), Survival Time, Kill Time and spore count. Your process validation protocol (PQ protocol) must clearly state that you will use the same calculation method specified by the supplier to confirm the D-value. Auditors easily spot inconsistencies such as "the supplier used LSK, but you used Survival Curve".

blocks.zh: 如果在 Survival Time 測試中，10 個 BI 中有 1 個沒有生長，這意味著什麼？你的 Survival Time 設定是否有問題？
blocks.en: If, in a Survival Time test, 1 of the 10 BIs shows no growth, what does this mean? Is there a problem with your Survival Time setting?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 要求「計算方法必須和 BI 製造商一致」？切換方法可能帶來什麼具體風險？
blocks.en: Why does USP require that "the calculation method must be consistent with the BI manufacturer"? What specific risks could switching methods bring?

blocks.zh: Clostridium sporogenes 需要特別的厭氧處理，這對哪種滅菌製程的 BI 驗證最相關？
blocks.en: Clostridium sporogenes requires special anaerobic handling. For which type of sterilization process is this most relevant to BI validation?

blocks.zh: USP 〈55〉 — ISO 11138 系列標準對照
blocks.en: USP <55> — Comparison with the ISO 11138 Series of Standards

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: D 值測定需使用符合 ISO 18472 的 BIER 裝置，最低要求：20 個複本 BI × 5 個暴露條件 = 100 次測試，時間間隔 NMT 75% of D-value
blocks.en: D-value determination requires a BIER vessel meeting ISO 18472; minimum requirement: 20 replicate BIs × 5 exposure conditions = 100 tests, with time intervals NMT 75% of D-value

blocks.zh: 滅菌暴露後必須在 4 小時內進行 BI 回收，培養觀察 7 天；孢子懸浮液在不同基材上的抗性可能與純水中測定結果不同，使用前需確認
blocks.en: BI recovery must be carried out within 4 hours after sterilization exposure, with 7 days of incubation observation; the resistance of spore suspensions on different substrates may differ from that determined in pure water and must be confirmed before use

blocks.zh: D 值可用 LSK、Survival Curve 或 Stumbo-Murphy-Cochran 三種方法計算；購買供應商 BI 時，必須使用與供應商相同的計算方法
blocks.en: The D-value can be calculated by three methods: LSK, Survival Curve or Stumbo-Murphy-Cochran; when purchasing BIs from a supplier, you must use the same calculation method as the supplier

blocks.zh: Survival Time（全部生長）和 Kill Time（全部無生長）各需 10 個 BI 樣品，由廠商提供並由使用者驗證；多相滅菌製程目前無 D 值測定方法
blocks.en: Survival Time (all growth) and Kill Time (all no growth) each require 10 BI samples, supplied by the manufacturer and verified by the user; no D-value determination method currently exists for multiple-phase sterilization processes
